services.name: Visual Art & Exhibitions
services.desc: The Eisemann Center main lobby, Ticket Office, Forrest & Virginia Green Mezzanine Gallery, and administrative office are open to the public from 10 am until 6 pm Monday through Saturday and during all public events. Entrance and exit are only through the main lobby front doors on Performance Court. The Forrest and Virginia Green Mezzanine Gallery is dedicated to showcasing the best of local and regional artists on the lobby upper level. With over 4,000 square feet of exhibition and reception space, there is room for everyone. Exhibits typically change monthly and promise a wealth of visual delight for patrons of all ages.
